prompt: A desktop web landing page and interactive learning hub for "THE IELTS DICTIONARY × WORD ATLAS", rendered edge to edge with crisp readable text and no browser window, device, or desk around it. The visitor's job is to immediately see their daily IELTS study path, interact with today's vocabulary card, and jump into one of four numbered modules. The concept is an international departure concourse and modular Bento Grid wayfinding board: warm birch-cream structural grid (#F4F1EA) contrasted with matte split-flap charcoal modules (#16181D), international wayfinding yellow plaques (#FACC15), British passport emerald (#065F46), and signal vermilion (#EA580C). Top frame holds the "TID × WORD ATLAS" mark, navigation links (01 Lộ Trình, 02 Hôm Nay Học Gì, 03 Word Atlas 7,298 Từ, 04 Đua Top VIP), a mechanical split-flap "14 DAYS STREAK" counter, and CTA button "Bắt Đầu Học Ngay". The first viewport is an asymmetric numbered Bento Grid: Cell "01 / LỘ TRÌNH ADAPTIVE" shows Band 5.0 → 7.5 route status; large central hero Cell "02 / HÔM NAY HỌC GÌ (FSRS QUEUE: 28 TỪ)" displays an interactive vocabulary card for "ubiquitous /juːˈbɪk.wɪ.təs/ (C1 - Technology)" with an illustrated contextual scene, UK/US audio waveform buttons, Vietnamese meaning "có mặt ở khắp mọi nơi", an Illustrated Cloze fill-in-the-blank sentence, and 4 FSRS memory rating buttons (Again 10m, Hard 1d, Good 4d, Easy 11d); Cell "03 / WORD ATLAS" shows 19 IELTS topic constellations; Cell "04 / ĐUA TOP SĂN VIP" shows the top 3 weekly XP leaderboard. Below the fold begins the 19 IELTS Topics Explorer section.
